host.description: The host name for the current node.

ip.description: The IP address for the current node.

port.description: The bound transport port for the current node.

type.description:
The thread pool type.
Returned values include `fixed`, `fixed_auto_queue_size`, `direct`, and `scaling`.

active.description: The number of active threads in the current thread pool.

pool_size.description: The number of threads in the current thread pool.

queue.description: The number of tasks currently in queue.

queue_size.description: The maximum number of tasks permitted in the queue.

largest.description: The highest number of active threads in the current thread pool.

core.description: The core number of active threads allowed in a scaling thread pool.

max.description: The maximum number of active threads allowed in a scaling thread pool.

size.description: The number of active threads allowed in a fixed thread pool.
